connection_type.description: Possible values:`Directly`, `PrivateLink`, `SshTunnel`. `SshTunnel` is used as a value if this parameter is omitted in the request and any of the following parameter's values is specified: `tunnel_host`, `tunnel_port`, `tunnel_user`. Otherwise, `Directly` is used as a value if the parameter is omitted.

host.description: DB instance host or IP address.

replica_id.description: Unique ID within the MySQL replica set. Must be an integer different from all other master and replica servers within the same group.

tunnel_host.description: SSH host, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer).

tunnel_port.description: SSH port, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

update_method.description:
The method to detect new or changed rows.
Supported values:
`BINLOG` - Fivetran uses your binary logs (also called binlogs) to request only the data that has changed since our last sync. This is the default value if no value is specified.
`TELEPORT` - Fivetran's proprietary replication method that uses compressed snapshots to detect and apply changes.
